justification.dataset: DANDI:000003 is Buzsaki-lab hippocampal (CA1) navigation data, not a canonical head-direction region, so the phenomenon is at best marginally and confoundedly present.
justification.handling: The committed figures were produced by generate_demo_figures.py from synthetic von Mises tuning curves and a random-walk trajectory, not from the real streamed recording, which is an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: The real pipeline uses a reasonable tuning-curve/resultant-vector approach but has no shuffle or null control, and the presented results are synthetic rather than computed from data.
justification.correctness: The headline numbers (mean DI 0.759, peak 6.90 Hz) originate from the seeded synthetic generator and do not reproduce from real-data code.
justification.figures: The polar curves are noiseless idealized von Mises blobs and the behavioral panel shows a 500 s random-walk cloud, displaying synthetic data instead of the claimed analysis.
justification.honesty: The write-up asserts 'No synthetic or simulated data were used' while every committed figure and headline number is synthetic, a direct fabrication.
justification.verdict: Synthetic data presented as real experimental results with a false no-synthetic-data claim mandates rejection.
